_about: Ad-industry prompt variations for Aurora editor-only inference on free Mixkit ad-commercial clips (Mixkit Free License, commercial use OK). Story: one source shoot -> many campaign variations without a reshoot. Each variation maps to a real advertising use case: colorway/SKU A-B, seasonal/holiday campaign, market localization, daypart (day vs night), and brand-grade tone matching.
_cfg_guidance: text_cfg=2.0 always. image_cfg=1.0 for weather/color/material/effects/relight/combined; image_cfg=1.5-2.0 for background swaps and full stylization.

clips.description: Woman modeling a short black dress in a studio

variations.prompt: change her dress from black to a deep ruby red
apply a high-fashion editorial black-and-white grade with rich contrast

clips.description: Stylish woman posing with a Camaro sports car

variations.prompt: keep the car and the woman in full vivid color while turning the entire background and surroundings black and white
make it a rainy downtown night with neon reflections on wet asphalt
repaint the car in glossy metallic midnight blue

clips.description: Man jogging on a city pedestrian bridge

variations.prompt: change his running top to bright neon volt yellow
turn it into a crisp autumn morning run with fallen leaves on the path

clips.description: Couple walking through a lavender field

variations.prompt: grade it as a dreamy pastel fragrance film with soft glowing bloom
add a soft golden-hour haze with warm backlit sunlight
